title: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
title_en: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
abstract_en: To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity (IKD) application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP (Electronic Population Card) which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25% of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3% who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.

title: Teknologi digital di era modern
title_en: Digital technology in the modern era
abstract_en: The development of digital technology in the last two decades has brought significant transformation in various fields, including theology. This research aims to analyze forms of use of digital technology in the study, practice and dissemination of information about theological doctrines, as well as their implications for the development of spirituality and religious education. Through a descriptive qualitative approach based on literature study, this research identifies that digital technology, such as online learning platforms, digital Bible applications, artificial intelligence (AI), and social media, provides access to broader theological knowledge, strengthens faith community interactions, and facilitates more flexible learning models. However, the author also highlights emerging challenges, including the risk of theological misinformation, reduced or even lost depth of spiritual reflection, and over-reliance on technology. This makes the author interested in discussing the topic of the role of digital technology in the era of modern theology. The results of this research show that the use of digital technology in modern theology brings great opportunities for the development of knowledge and practice of faith, but still requires a critical and ethical approach to remain in harmony with correct theological foundations.

title_en: Information Systems Management
abstract_en: Project management is an important aspect of information systems management to ensure smooth project implementation and ensure efficient utilization of resources. The success of any project depends on communication, risk, cost management and timely decision making. Quality assessment is carried out to evaluate the reliability, validity and strength of evidence of each selected data. The data analyzed will answer research questions and discuss dominant methods and approaches from 2019-2023. In the search process, inclusion and exclusion criteria were used to identify relevant studies and quality assessment was used to determine whether a study met the inclusion criteria in the review. Project management and SLR methodology can be used as an effective tool for managing projects in the context of information systems management. Therefore, this research aims to identify case studies and research methods regarding project management using data obtained from related journals in the period 2019–2023.

title: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
title_en: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
abstract_en: To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity (IKD) application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP (Electronic Population Card) which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25% of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3% who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.

title: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
title_en: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
abstract_en: To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity (IKD) application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP (Electronic Population Card) which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25% of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3% who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.

title: Analisis Keamanan Aplikasi Mobile Commerce Menggunakan Mobile Security Framework (Mobsf) dan Owasp Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (Mastg)
title_en: Mobile Commerce Application Security Analysis Using Mobile Security Framework (Mobsf) and Owasp Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (Mastg)
abstract_en: The XYZ application is the flagship application of the X Province government which is used for public services. This application is a bridge between the Provincial government and the RW Chair. In this research, a security assessment was carried out on the XYZ application to identify vulnerabilities and the impact of vulnerabilities, value vulnerabilities, and provide security recommendations for the identified vulnerabilities. The vulnerabilities identified refer to vulnerabilities from the OWASP Mobile Top Ten 2016. This research uses a security assessment method based on SANS which consists of three steps, namely reviewing, examining, and testing. The reviewing stage is carried out by collecting information related to the XYZ application, provincial government policies, and related to the NDA. The examination stage is also called static analysis, here automatic static analysis is carried out using the MobSF scanner and the MARA Framework. Then the testing or dynamic analysis stage carries out vulnerability testing by running the application. Based on the security assessment results, six vulnerabilities were identified in the This discovered vulnerability resulted in the loss of confidentiality aspects such as sensitive user data, default passwords and application configuration keys with the backend server contained in the source code. Based on these vulnerabilities, security recommendations are provided in the form of implementing data encryption, implementing obfuscation techniques, and carrying out key management for the purpose of overcoming vulnerabilities and preventing impacts from occurring.

title: Analisis sentimen berbasis aspek pada ulasan aplikasi tangerang live menggunakan latent dirichlet allocation dan naïve bayes
title_en: Aspect-based sentiment analysis on Tangerang Live application reviews using latent Dirichlet allocation and Naïve Bayes
abstract_en: The public complaint service system is an important means for the city government to receive, process and follow up on various citizen complaints. However, the increasing volume of complaint data in the city of Surabaya has become a challenge due to less effective manual management. In-depth analysis of complaint data is needed to understand public opinion on service quality. This research aims to carry out aspect-based sentiment analysis of complaint data. The research was conducted using the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) method to identify the main aspects of complaints and using Multinomial Naïve Bayes (MNB) to classify sentiment. The data used consists of 10,847 complaints collected via the WargaKu application and Media Center throughout 2023. The LDA method succeeded in identifying 17 main topics, including administration, infrastructure and public information. Furthermore, the MNB Model achieved 80% accuracy after applying resampling, proving its reliability in sentiment classification. The research results provide relevant insights to help city governments prioritize improvements on key issues and offer approaches that similar complaint systems can adopt

title: Evaluasi dan Perbaikan Desain User Interface Aplikasi Mall Kiniku Menggunakan Metode Usability Testing dan Pendekatan Human Centered Design (Hcd)
title_en: Evaluation and Improvement of User Interface Design for Kiniku Mall Application Using Usability Testing Method and Human Centered Design (HCD) Approach
abstract_en: In the midst of rapid advances in technology and internet use, the National Narcotics Agency (BNN) as a government agency has built a website for the purposes of disseminating information and accelerating communication for the wider community. This research focuses on evaluating and improving the user interface of the official BNN website using Usability Testing and the Human-Centered Design (HCD) approach. HCD is an approach to developing interactive systems with the aim of making the system usable and useful. Usability testing is the process of testing a website to determine ease of use by users. The research stages start from user identification, user needs analysis, initial design usability testing evaluation, solution design creation, and solution design usability testing evaluation. The research results show that by using the HCD method there is an increase in usability in the aspects of effectiveness and efficiency from the initial design of 96% to 100% in the solution design. Apart from that, the average processing time was also faster from 45.28 seconds for the initial design to 9.36 seconds for the solution design.

title: Development of web-based spatial information system tourism industry event distribution (case study)
title_en: Development of web-based spatial information system tourism industry event distribution (case study)
abstract_en: In recent years, the number and scope of events in the Asia and Middle East / North Africa region has increased significantly. Events are one of the things that attracts the attention of foreign tourists to come to visit a country as a tourist destination. Refers toMinister of Tourism Regulation Number 2 Year 2017on Guidelines for Venues for Meetings, Incentive Trips, Conventions and Exhibitions, explains that criteria and indicators are needed to increase the competitiveness of venues for meetings, incentive trips, conventions and exhibitions at the regional and global levels. This is done to increase the number of visits, length of stay, and expenditures for domestic and foreign tourists. Therefore, visual indicators or data are needed that can present the location of the event and a list of events in DKI Jakarta. From these problems, this study aims to produce a web-based spatial information system for the distribution of tourism industry events to map event locations in DKI Jakarta. The methodology used in collecting this data is the method of observation, interviews, and literature studies. While the system development methodology uses PHP and MySQL with the Rapid Application Development (RAD) approach and uses the Unified Modeling Language (UML) which is a tool for system description and design, as well as the Google Maps API for digital maps. The results of this study are in the form of a spatial information system that can display a map of the distribution of event locations in DKI Jakarta based on event data and event categories at the DKI Jakarta Tourism and Creative Economy Department. title: Analisis sentimen pada media sosial twitter terhadap tokoh gus dur menggunakan metode Naïve Bayes dan Support Vector Machine (SVM)
title_en: Sentiment analysis on Twitter social media towards the figure Gus Dur using the Naïve Bayes method and Support Vector Machine (SVM)
abstract_en: Diaspora players are increasingly playing an important role in the Indonesian national football team squad. This research aims to analyze public sentiment on Twitter (X) regarding two diaspora players, Mees Hilgers and Elliano Reindjs, by utilizing the Naïve Bayes and Support Vector Machine algorithms and dividing them into positive, negative and neutral classes. The results of this research show that public sentiment towards diaspora players in the Indonesian national football team tends to be positive with a percentage value of 71.2% or 640 positive tweets, then 25.5% or 229 negative tweets and 3.3% or 30 neutral tweets. This research uses the SEMMA method (Sample, Explore, Modify, Model, Assess) as a research methodology reference. The Support Vector Machine method with a ratio of 90:10 with parameters C: 100, gamma: 0.1 and kernel: rbf has better accuracy results compared to the Naïve Bayes method at the same ratio, with a comparison percentage of 86% : 74%. Through this study, researchers want to understand public perceptions of diaspora players and their contribution to the development of Indonesian football. It is hoped that the results of this research can provide deeper insight into the dynamics of public opinion on social media regarding national football issues.

title: Pengaruh Etika Profesi Terhadap Keamanan Informasi Dalam Konteks Kebocoran Data Bsi (Bank Syariah Indonesia): Studi Literatur Sistematis
title_en: The Influence of Professional Ethics on Information Security in the Context of BSI (Indonesian Sharia Bank) Data Leak: Systematic Literature Study
abstract_en: This study examines scientific publications from the last five years that highlight the relationship between the ethical behavior of information technology practitioners and cybercrime prevention, particularly in the context of organizational data security. As an empirical illustration, the data leak incident experienced by BSI in 2023 is used to strengthen conceptual findings. The study results show that ethical values ​​such as responsibility, accountability, and awareness of information security have an important role in forming an effective security culture. This research aims to evaluate the role of professional ethics in maintaining information security using a systematic review approach to relevant scientific literature. In recent years, increasing threats to organizational data have shown that technical aspects alone are not enough to prevent information leakage incidents. The research method used was SLR with the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis) method. This research contributes to the understanding of the importance of integrating ethical principles in information technology governance, as well as offering recommendations for strengthening regulations and ethical training in the IT professional environment.

title: Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model
title_en: Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model
abstract_en: The Distance Education System (DES) is a learning system by using online application facilities through internet that rapidly adopted in the education sector. However, there has been many obstacles and problems that hinder learning activities. It has been implemented in all level of education in Indonesia even more during pandemic Covid-19. DES is one of the innovations that have been adopted in education sector, hence its kind of technology can influence the intention of learning. The purpose of this study is to measure an individual perception on behavioural intention to use of Distance Education Systems (DES) in the province of DKI Jakarta area. Researchers used a combination of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Innovation Diffusion Theory (IDT) research models. The sampling technique used is purposive sampling, which only selects the students of Islamic Junior high school (Madrasah Aliyah Negeri/MAN) in the province of DKI Jakarta area. The data analysis method used is PLS-SEM with the product software of SmartPLS 3.3.3. The results of the study indicate that 8 out of 13 hypotheses are accepted. The variable that has the greatest influence on behavioural intention to use is compatibility mediated by perceived usefulness. The results found that three IDT variables (relative advantages, complexity, trialability) have a significant effect on the perceived usefulness variable, then lead to it has a significant relationship on behavioral intention to use. In addition, the two of IDT variable namely compatibility and trialability have significant effect on the perceived ease of use then it has a significant effect on behavioral intention to use. The study found that the behavioural intention to use of DES influenced by the innovation characteristics (IDT) and mediated by the characteristics of technology itself (TAM).

title: Analisis Etika Penggunaan Data Konsumen dalam Platform E-Commerce
title_en: Ethical Analysis of Consumer Data Use in E-Commerce Platforms
abstract_en: The growth of e-commerce platforms in Indonesia is encouraging the collection of consumer data on an unprecedented scale, but management practices are not yet fully ethical. The main problem that arises is the gap between the ethical principles of data use that should be applied and actual practice in the field, which is exacerbated by weak regulatory enforcement and low consumer awareness of their personal rights. This research aims to analyze the ethical principles of using consumer data in e-commerce platforms, examine the regulatory framework that regulates it and the challenges of its implementation, and identify the relationship between ethical data practices and consumer trust. The method used is a literature review with a descriptive qualitative approach. A total of 21 scientific journal articles published between 2022 and 2026 were thematically analyzed into five main themes: ethical use of consumer data, privacy protection and regulation, data misuse and leakage, consumer trust, and the role of technology and information systems. The results of the study show that the principles of transparency and informed consent are still treated as formalities by many platforms, rather than as substantive ethical commitments. The Personal Data Protection Law of 2022 is an important regulatory milestone, but its implementation is still hampered by weak law enforcement and low consumer digital literacy. The 2020 Tokopedia data leak case which exposed more than 91 million accounts proves that the company's ethical negligence has a direct impact on consumer trust. This research concludes that ethical data governance requires integration between internal company commitment, strengthening regulations, adopting data protection technologies such as blockchain and privacy by design, and simultaneously increasing consumer digital literacy.

title: Continuance Use Intention Analysis on Paid Streaming Service Using Expectation-Confirmation Model (ECM)
title_en: Continuance Use Intention Analysis on Paid Streaming Service Using Expectation-Confirmation Model (ECM)
abstract_en: Netflix was a paid streaming service in Indonesia in January 2016. However, it turns out that Netflix is the only option for using paid streaming services in Indonesia. According to research by Media Partner Asia (MPA), in Indonesia itself, Netflix is still unable to compete with the newcomer streaming service, namely Disney+ Hotstar, and many Internet users in Indonesia are still happy to access illegal streaming sites, so piracy actors continue to appear even though the government has been aggressively close their service. This study aims to analyze continuance use intention or intentions sustainable use of the Netflix paid streaming service in Indonesia and determine what factors influence it based on the proposed model. The main model of this research is the Expectation-Confirmation Model (ECM), which is a user satisfaction model that influences the user's intention to reuse an application by adding the variables habit, enjoyment, subjective norm, and perceived playfulness. The PLS-SEM method, with the help of SmartPLS 4 tools, was used to analyze an online survey of 320 respondents. The results show that habit is the biggest predictor of continuance use intention, followed by subjective norms, perceived usefulness, and finally, perceived playfulness. It is proven that confirmation greatly influences perceived usefulness. The findings of this research provide an opportunity better to understand the long-term viability of Netflix in Indonesia.

title: Penerapan machine learning sebagai instrumen penegakan etika komunikasi digital dalam memitigasi penyebaran berita bohong
title_en: Application of machine learning as an instrument for enforcing digital communication ethics in mitigating the spread of fake news
abstract_en: The rapid spread of disinformation in the digital era poses a systemic threat to communication ethics, overwhelming manual verification capacities. This study aims to develop and evaluate an automatic text classification model using Machine Learning as a preventive instrument to mitigate fake news and uphold public information rights. Employing a quantitative experimental approach, the study compared five classification algorithms—Logistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Linear SVC, Random Forest, and Passive Aggressive—using TF-IDF vectorization on a dataset of 6,335 news articles. Model evaluation prioritized the F1-Score and False Positive metrics to address ethical risks. The results demonstrated that the Linear Support Vector Classification (Linear SVC) outperformed other models, achieving the highest F1-Score of 93.67% and an accuracy of 93.76%. Crucially, the Linear SVC model recorded a minimal False Positive rate, misclassifying only 30 fake articles. This indicates its reliability and ethical accountability as an algorithmic filter. The study concludes that Linear SVC is highly effective for fake news mitigation, though human digital literacy remains the ultimate defense.

abstract_en: Personal data breaches pose a serious threat amid Indonesia's rapid digital transformation, involving government institutions and e-commerce platforms. title: Analisis sentimen pada ulasan aplikasi smart city menggunakan pemodelan latent dirichlet allocation dan klasifikasi naïve bayes
title_en: Sentiment analysis in smart city application reviews using latent dirichlet allocation modeling and naïve Bayes classification
abstract_en: AbstractThe National Non-Cash Movement (GNNT) launched by Bank Indonesia has encouraged significant growth in the use of e-wallets as a means of digital payment. ShopeePay is one of the dominant platforms with market penetration reaching 68%. This research aims to analyze user sentiment towards the ShopeePay application and interpret the dominant sentiment topics in user reviews. The method used is sentiment analysis with the Naïve Bayes algorithm and topic modeling using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) based on Google Play Store review data for the period January–December 2024. The analysis results show a model accuracy of 89.70% with precision of 82%, recall of 86%, and F1-score of 84%. Of the 2,811 preprocessed reviews, the model predicted 2,183 reviews were positive, while 628 reviews were negative. Topic analysis revealed that users were satisfied with transaction ease, system reliability and service quality with a coherence of 0.5157 in topic group 7, while the main complaints were related to technical issues with accounts and loan services with a coherence value of 0.3453 in topic group 10. These findings provide recommendations for developers to improve service quality regarding handling technical issues and loan features. Keywords: ShopeePay, Naïve Bayes, Latent Dirichlet Allocation, Sentiment analysis

title: Penerapan balance scorecard pada perguruan tinggi di Indonesia: Tinjauan literatur sistematis
title_en: Implementation of the balanced scorecard in higher education in Indonesia: A systematic literature review
abstract_en: By implementing good education, a country can develop the mindset of its people to be of higher quality and can make that country be seen and taken into account by other countries. The main aim of writing this paper is to find out the extent of the benefits of using a balanced scorecard at a university in Indonesia. Systematic Literature Review is the method used in this research. As time goes by, more and more universities are implementing this balanced scorecard strategy. This balanced scorecard is used as an instrument in measuring the performance of related universities. Of the 23 universities discussed in this paper, 82.61% of them use 4 balanced scorecard perspectives simultaneously. Meanwhile, the rest of the universities only use 3 or even 1 perspective. This is because each university has its own concept or arrangement. Apart from that, there is a lot of literature that shows that the balanced scorecard has various useful values, especially in achieving strategy and improving organizational performance. Based on several studies, the implementation status of the balanced scorecard also shows a minimal failure rate and a relatively high success rate. The use of the balanced scorecard is also useful for universities in knowing their operational performance. With the results of the balanced scorecard, if the value is still not sufficient, the university can further improve its quality, focusing on aspects of the value that are not sufficient.

abstract_en: The Application and Data Development (PAD) Section is a Sub-Section of the Bogor Regency DISKOMINFO E-Government Sector which has the task of monitoring system development activities. In its implementation, the PAD section has problems related to employee competency which has not reached standards in system (application) development and has not implemented PERBUB No. 11 of 2015 concerning system implementation and development. Therefore, researchers conducted an evaluation using the COBIT 5 and ISO/IEC 38500 frameworks. This research used the Process Assessment Model (PAM) with the Guttman scale to determine the results and capability level. The focus domains used are EDM04 Ensure Resource Management and MEA01 Monitor, Evaluate and Assess Performance and Conformance. The results and capability level for current conditions (as is) is level 2 Managed Process with a value of 2.38. Meanwhile, the expected condition (to be) is at level 3 Established Process with a value of 3.00 so it has a gap of 0.62, from which recommendations for improvement are then made based on the activities of ISO/IEC 38500.

title: Systematic Literature Review terhadap Pemanfaatan Internet of Things (IoT) dalam Bidang Kesehatan
title_en: Systematic Literature Review of the Use of the Internet of Things (IoT) in the Health Sector
abstract_en: Currently the Internet of Things (IoT) is growing rapidly. With its sophisticated technology, IoT is able to provide various positive impacts, such as efficiency, effectiveness and speed in carrying out certain tasks, especially in the health sector. The existence of IoT in the health sector is very important in monitoring patient conditions quickly and practically. The large amount of research on the use of IoT in the health sector can help researchers or related parties in developing IoT in the medical world. Therefore, a literature review is needed regarding the use of IoT in the health sector so that information can be classified systematically. This research aims to identify and analyze the latest research related to the use of IoT in the health sector from 2020 to 2021 using the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method with the help of Publish or Perish, Mendeley, Zotero, and Microsoft Excel tools. The research results show that of the 129 IoT articles in Quartile 1 of 2020-2021, there are 10 articles related to IoT in the health sector which are divided into 4 topics, where the most researched topic is the direct impact of IoT in the health sector, with a percentage of 50%, followed by the topic of data transmission efficiency related to the use of IoT in the health sector at 20%, security issues regarding IoT in the health sector at 20%, and the use or use of energy in IoT in the health sector at 10%.

title: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
title_en: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
abstract_en: The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students/women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media (Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram) on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach's alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.

title: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
title_en: Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model
abstract_en: To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity (IKD) application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP (Electronic Population Card) which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25% of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3% who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.

title: Student perceptions of user satisfaction and user loyalty of website based e-learning
title_en: Student perceptions of user satisfaction and user loyalty of website based e-learning
abstract_en: This paper discusses the importance of information technology development in facilitating human life through website-based e-learning. E-learning accelerates the dissemination of knowledge, particularly during the Covid-19 pandemic when online learning surged. However, users encounter challenges, such as unclear task instructions and platform errors. This research aims to enhance the quality of e-learning services by analyzing students’ perceptions of user satisfaction and loyalty on three major e-learning platforms in Indonesia. The study employs the EUCS model augmented with System Quality dimensions. Respondents are middle and high school students in DKI Jakarta who have used one of the e-learning platforms. The results from 209 respondents indicate high user satisfaction, scoring 85.93, and a high level of user loyalty, scoring 84.69. Factors such as Content, Format, Ease of use, Timeliness, Instructor quality, and Course Materials show a positive relationship with user satisfaction, with Course Materials being the most influential. However, hypotheses regarding Accuracy, Administrative and support service quality, and Security and privacy did not prove to have a significant impact. This research is expected to expand the understanding of factors influencing user satisfaction and loyalty in website-based e-learning and provide guidance for improving the quality of e-learning to enhance student satisfaction and loyalty.

title: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
title_en: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
abstract_en: The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students/women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media (Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram) on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach's alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.

The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students/women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media (Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram) on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach's alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.

abstract_en:
The global food system is currently facing increasingly complex multidimensional pressures due to the interaction of ecological, social, economic and political crises. Climate change, land degradation, loss of biodiversity, and inequality in the structure of the food economy have increased the vulnerability of food production systems in various regions. In this context, agroecology is developing as an alternative approach that emphasizes the integration of ecological principles, social sustainability, and strengthening local economies in agricultural systems. This research aims to analyze the role of agroecology in the transformation of sustainable food systems and examine its relevance to local agricultural practices in Indonesia. The research uses a systematic literature review (SLR) approach by analyzing various international scientific publications, global institutional reports, and academic literature relevant to agroecology and sustainable food systems. The analysis was carried out through identifying main themes which include the global food system crisis, agroecological principles and theoretical framework, developments in agroecological research, local Indonesian agricultural practices, as well as obstacles to the implementation of agroecology. The results of the study show that agroecology has great potential in increasing the resilience of agroecosystems through production diversification, efficient use of resources, and strengthening community institutions. Local agricultural practices in Indonesia such as agroforestry, mixed plantations, subak, and mina padi show strong compatibility with agroecological principles and have the potential to support a more sustainable food system. However, the widespread implementation of agroecology still faces various structural obstacles, including the dominance of external input-based agricultural policies, weak farmer institutions, and limited access to technology and markets. This research shows that agroecology can be an important conceptual framework in transforming the food system towards a more resilient, just and sustainable model through the integration of local knowledge, scientific innovation and inclusive public policies.
 
Key words: agroecologist; sustainable food systems; food system transformation; biodiversity-based agriculture.

title: E-Services Quality: An Analysis of Customer's Mobile Banking Services in Sharia—A Systematic Literature Review
title_en: E-Services Quality: An Analysis of Customer's Mobile Banking Services in Sharia—A Systematic Literature Review
abstract_en: In the current digital era, banking services have rapidly evolved thanks to technological advancements, such as mobile banking, which allows customers to conduct transactions easily and efficiently. Studies show that customer perception and satisfaction levels highly depend on service standards, available features, and user experience when using the service. Studies have shown that how customers feel about a service and how satisfied they are with it relies a lot on the quality of the service, the features it offers, and how easy it is to use. A big part of how well financial services on mobile devices do is how good digital services are, particularly in sharia banking that operates in accordance with Sharia principles and regulations. This research aims to gather systematic literature about the level of quality in mobile banking features provided by sharia-compliant banks. To comprehend the connection between customer experience and the effectiveness of e-services in mobile banking apps, the modified e-services quality model is essential. Finding the elements that affect the quality of e-services and consumer happiness, as well as investigating methods for enhancing digital services in compliance with sharia law, are the main goals of this study. It is anticipated that the findings of this study will offer more profound understandings of how Islamic banks may enhance the quality of their mobile banking services.

title: Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model
title_en: Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model
abstract_en: The Distance Education System (DES) is a learning system by using online application facilities through internet that rapidly adopted in the education sector. However, there has been many obstacles and problems that hinder learning activities. It has been implemented in all level of education in Indonesia even more during pandemic Covid-19. DES is one of the innovations that have been adopted in education sector, hence its kind of technology can influence the intention of learning. The purpose of this study is to measure an individual perception on behavioural intention to use of Distance Education Systems (DES) in the province of DKI Jakarta area. Researchers used a combination of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Innovation Diffusion Theory (IDT) research models. The sampling technique used is purposive sampling, which only selects the students of Islamic Junior high school (Madrasah Aliyah Negeri/MAN) in the province of DKI Jakarta area. The data analysis method used is PLS-SEM with the product software of SmartPLS 3.3.3. The results of the study indicate that 8 out of 13 hypotheses are accepted. The variable that has the greatest influence on behavioural intention to use is compatibility mediated by perceived usefulness. The results found that three IDT variables (relative advantages, complexity, trialability) have a significant effect on the perceived usefulness variable, then lead to it has a significant relationship on behavioral intention to use. In addition, the two of IDT variable namely compatibility and trialability have significant effect on the perceived ease of use then it has a significant effect on behavioral intention to use. The study found that the behavioural intention to use of DES influenced by the innovation characteristics (IDT) and mediated by the characteristics of technology itself (TAM).

title: Analisis sentimen pada media sosial twitter terhadap tokoh gus dur menggunakan metode Naïve Bayes dan Support Vector Machine (SVM)
title_en: Sentiment analysis on Twitter social media towards the figure Gus Dur using the Naïve Bayes method and Support Vector Machine (SVM)
abstract_en: Diaspora players are increasingly playing an important role in the Indonesian national football team squad. This research aims to analyze public sentiment on Twitter (X) regarding two diaspora players, Mees Hilgers and Elliano Reindjs, by utilizing the Naïve Bayes and Support Vector Machine algorithms and dividing them into positive, negative and neutral classes. The results of this research show that public sentiment towards diaspora players in the Indonesian national football team tends to be positive with a percentage value of 71.2% or 640 positive tweets, then 25.5% or 229 negative tweets and 3.3% or 30 neutral tweets. This research uses the SEMMA method (Sample, Explore, Modify, Model, Assess) as a research methodology reference. The Support Vector Machine method with a ratio of 90:10 with parameters C: 100, gamma: 0.1 and kernel: rbf has better accuracy results compared to the Naïve Bayes method at the same ratio, with a comparison percentage of 86% : 74%. Through this study, researchers want to understand public perceptions of diaspora players and their contribution to the development of Indonesian football. It is hoped that the results of this research can provide deeper insight into the dynamics of public opinion on social media regarding national football issues.

title: Pengujian Kebergunaan Sistem Berdasarkan Kepuasan Penggunanya Menggunakan Use Questionnaire
title_en: System Usability Testing Based on User Satisfaction Using Use Questionnaire
abstract_en: The use of information technology (IT) has unavoidably become an important part of supporting a company's business success. This research aims to determine the success of the Commuter Vending system by railway companies in Indonesia based on the usability of the system. The aim of this research is to obtain the feasibility value of the commuter vending application using a use questionnaire. Researchers used a questionnaire tool to collect user experience data from system implementation. The measurement results show the usability of the system is around 75.92%. Apart from that, there is a significant influence between the variables usability, ease of use, and ease of learning on the satisfaction variable carried out impartially. It can be seen that the lowest average value is for the Ease of Learning variable at 15.93 and the highest average value for the variable is Ease of Use at 40.45 due to the respondents' experience in feeling ease when using the application.

title: Sistem Pendukung Keputusan
title_en: Decision Support Systems
abstract_en: Advances in digital transformation have had an impact on the complexity of decision-making processes in various sectors, especially with the increasing volume of large and varied data. In this context, efficient tools are needed to evaluate multi-criteria alternatives objectively. Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) has emerged as one of the methods that is widely used in Decision Support Systems (DSS). However, systematic studies discussing the development and application of this method in various contexts are still very limited. This research aims to conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) on the development of SAW-based SPK with a focus on identifying application platforms, design methods and benefits of implementation. In this research, the Systematic Literature Review method was used with an approach that follows Kitchenham's guidelines. The research results show that web-based platforms dominate DSS development because of their flexibility, ease of access, and ability to support real-time decision making. In addition, the Prototyping design method is often used because it allows dynamic adjustment of the system to user needs. The application of the SAW method has consistently been proven to increase accuracy, time efficiency, transparency and user confidence in the decision-making process.

Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) has emerged as one of the methods that is widely used in Decision Support Systems (DSS). However, systematic studies discussing the development and application of this method in various contexts are still very limited. This research aims to conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) on the development of SAW-based SPK with a focus on identifying application platforms, design methods and benefits of implementation. In this research, the Systematic Literature Review method was used with an approach that follows Kitchenham's guidelines. The research results show that web-based platforms dominate DSS development because of their flexibility, ease of access, and ability to support real-time decision making. In addition, the Prototyping design method is often used because it allows dynamic adjustment of the system to user needs. The application of the SAW method has consistently been proven to increase accuracy, time efficiency, transparency and user confidence in the decision-making process.

title: Effective IT Governance in Higher Education Institutions: The Conceptual Model
title_en: Effective IT Governance in Higher Education Institutions: The Conceptual Model
abstract_en: Recently, a considerable literature has grown up around the theme of Information Technology Governance (ITG) in the organization. While some research has been carry out on ITG in general, there is still very little scientific understanding of Effective ITG in the context of Higher Education Institutions (HEI). To gain the effectiveness of IT governance in HEIs need to follow the IT governance mechanisms that provide the set of process and procedures which is in line with the strategic alignment between IT and business. In essence, Effective IT governance will guarantee alignment between IT and the business goals. Organizations with vain IT governance will hurt due to poor performance of IT resources such as inefficient operating costs, inaccurate information quality, and even the decease of its IT department. This paper offer the effective of IT governance evaluation model that may can be used by organizational management in the HEI in particular. Furthermore, this study identifies the factors that contribute to effective IT governance based on past literatures on this domain. The proposed model need to be tested through empirical study in the future work by others. The result of the study can help to HEIs management to gain the effective IT governance implementation. Other than, this study will contribute to the knowledge of IT governance implementation in HEIs.

title: Forecasting the Inventory of Milled Dry Grain Using the Lot Sizing Method at Markom Rice Mill
title_en: Forecasting the Inventory of Milled Dry Grain Using the Lot Sizing Method at Markom Rice Mill
abstract_en: Today's industrial activities are increasing with sophisticated technology, all applied to satisfy consumers in various services. One of the important parts of an industry is the inventory of goods. This is related to the continuity of the resulting production. In meeting the needs of consumers, a plan is needed in production so that there is no shortage of raw materials and the production process does not stop. Grain is an agricultural commodity whose demand and production levels occasionally increase. We can see that until now, our country, Indonesia, still imports rice from other countries, where rice is the main production product produced from grain. The problem can be solved with the Lot sizing method used in this study, which is used to determine the size of the order quantity. In the rice mill itself, grain storage has a limited capacity, so it cannot be directly stored with a large capacity when the price of grain is down. Applying this method as an application will make it easier to manage grain inventory at the rice mill and estimate inventory costs for the next 1 () year. The results of the lot sizing calculation (silver meal) show that for the next year, the smallest cost of procurement of dry milled grain (MDG) demand is obtained from the procurement of demand every month. In other words, procurement is more appropriate every month or period so that the costs incurred for grain inventory are smaller. The following data are the results of the silver meal lot sizing calculation: (1) 39015.4 kg, (2) 35871.2 kg, (3) 39536 kg, (4) 33894.8 kg, (5) 31402 kg, (6) 27982.5 kg, (7) 41461.9 kg, (8) 35336.7 kg, (9) 41305.6 kg, (10) 45717.5 kg, (11) 42007.9 kg, (12) 50828 kg. The cost incurred per order is Rp. 6,000,000

title: Analisis sentimen berbasis aspek pada ulasan aplikasi tangerang live menggunakan latent dirichlet allocation dan naïve bayes
title_en: Aspect-based sentiment analysis on Tangerang Live application reviews using latent Dirichlet allocation and Naïve Bayes
abstract_en: The public complaint service system is an important means for the city government to receive, process and follow up on various citizen complaints. However, the increasing volume of complaint data in the city of Surabaya has become a challenge due to less effective manual management. In-depth analysis of complaint data is needed to understand public opinion on service quality. This research aims to carry out aspect-based sentiment analysis of complaint data. The research was conducted using the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) method to identify the main aspects of complaints and using Multinomial Naïve Bayes (MNB) to classify sentiment. The data used consists of 10,847 complaints collected via the WargaKu application and Media Center throughout 2023. The LDA method succeeded in identifying 17 main topics, including administration, infrastructure and public information. Furthermore, the MNB Model achieved 80% accuracy after applying resampling, proving its reliability in sentiment classification. The research results provide relevant insights to help city governments prioritize improvements on key issues and offer approaches that similar complaint systems can adopt

title: Sistem Informasi Perbankan Syariah
title_en: Sharia Banking Information System
abstract_en: This research reviews Digital Transformation in Sharia Banking Information Systems. This research aims to explore the challenges and opportunities faced by Islamic financial institutions in adopting digital transformation, with a focus on the social and economic impacts on Muslim communities. The methodology used is a qualitative descriptive approach through literature study to collect and analyze data from various trusted sources, which involves analysis of literature related to the development of information technology-based sharia banking. The results show that the digitalization of Islamic banking has brought significant changes in the operations of financial institutions, with an emphasis on fairness and profits in financial transactions. In addition, this transformation improves customer experience through personalization of services, expanding financial inclusion and increasing public financial literacy which in turn encourages active participation in the sharia financial system.  However, challenges such as policy, integration and technical regulations need to be addressed to ensure the success of this transformation and customer protection.

title: Technology acceptance model perilaku pengguna pada sistem enterprise dompet dhuafa
title_en: Technology acceptance model of user behavior in the dhuafa wallet enterprise system
abstract_en: Dompet Dhuafa Enterprise System (DESI) is a system created in 2015. Initially it was created to replace the Fundrising Administration System (SANDRA) because SANDRA is a desktop-based application. Nowadays DESI is only used for budgeting functions and “Tebar Hewan Kurban” (THK) its a sacrificial animal stocking functions. DESI which has daily functions such as budgeting and seasonal functions in THK. In its implementation, DESI which is a web-based system sometimes becomes difficult to access when the system has a problem. This certainly makes the budgeting function that is used in daily activities become not implemented. THK's function in DESI was also inseparable from problems, one of which was the presence of volunteers who did not directly enter the data of prospective victims into DESI during the THK implementation. New data entered into DESI on the first Tasyrik day, for example, will increase work in other divisions. It would be different if it had been done before the sacrificial feast. This study aims to determine the factors that influence the acceptance behavior of DESI users. In this quantitative study using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) model. Sampling in this study using purposive sampling and accidental sampling. This study uses PLS-SEM for data processing and uses the application of SmartPLS version 3. There are 6 variables examined in this study, namely perceived usefulness, perceived easy of use, format, attitude using, behavioral intention to use, and actual system usage. From 7 hypotheses proposed there is one hypothesis that is rejected, namely the path attitude toward using the behavioral intention to use.

title: Analisis dan pengembangan strategi pemasaran digital di lkp ilma modeste menggunakan metode sostac
title_en: Analysis and development of digital marketing strategies at LKP Ilma Modeste using the Sostac method
abstract_en: This research aims to examine the digital marketing information system strategy implemented by CV. AUFCO in developing their electronic trading business by implementing the SOSTAC method. The SOSTAC method is used as a guideline for developing and implementing digital marketing strategies, which include the stages of Specification, Objectives, Strategy, Tactics, Action and Control. This research uses a descriptive qualitative approach by collecting primary data through in-depth interviews with related parties at AUFCO. The research results reveal that AUFCO has succeeded in implementing effective digital marketing strategies to increase revenue, expand markets and increase customer satisfaction. The use of SOSTAC helps AUFCO in formulating targeted business objectives, determining the right target market, and developing efficient marketing tactics. Evaluation of strategy implementation shows that AUFCO has succeeded in achieving most of the targets set, although there are still obstacles in facing tight business competition and changes in unstable economic conditions. This research contributes ideas in deepening understanding of the application of SOSTAC in the context of electronic commerce, as well as providing suggestions for other business actors who are interested in adopting a similar strategy.

title_en: Design and build a savings transaction system for web-based waste management (Case study: Sahitya Waste Bank, Faculty of Science and Technology, UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta)
abstract_en: Sahitya Waste Bank is an organization initiated by DEMA FST which is intended for all students of UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta to support the management of inorganic waste into valuable goods thereby creating additional income. The increasing number of customers in all faculties has caused treasurers to be overwhelmed in ordering the ranking of customers and have not been on target in determining the best customers with the same weight of waste. Apart from that, there is no system security in handling the transaction process so that unwanted access can occur. The aim of this research is to develop a savings transaction system for waste management in the faculty to make UINSyarif Hidayatullah Jakarta Green Campus. The decision making method uses Simple AdditiveWeighting (SAW). The system development methodology used is Rapid Application Development (RAD). The tools used in system design are Unified Modeling Language (UML). The implementation of this system uses the PHP programming language with the Laravel and MySQL framework as database processing. The resulting system can simplify and speed up the process of recording and managing waste bank data.

title: Usability Testing Pada Website Bisnis PIKAPP Indonesia Dengan Kuesioner Nielsen Attributes Of Usability (NAU)
title_en: Usability Testing on the PIKAPP Indonesia Business Website Using the Nielsen Attributes of Usability (NAU) Questionnaire
abstract_en: PikApp Indonesia is one of the start-ups in Indonesia which operates in the information technology sector which supports Food and Beverage (F&B) business owners or MSMEs by offering technological features, one of which is a business website which contains a digital menu and can be accessed by scanning the QR Code provided. This feature offers convenience for consumers and merchants themselves. Usability testing carried out in this research aims to determine consumer assessments of the digital business website menus offered and find out what problems are often encountered when accessing the website. Usability testing is carried out using the Nielsen Attributes of Usability (NAU) questionnaire which contains five criteria or factors, namely learnability, memorability, efficiency, errors, and satisfaction. The results of usability testing from this research show that the website can be said to be usable, which means it is easy to use, with final scores in the form of learnability (0.880), memorability (0.876), efficiency (0.867), errors (0.885), and satisfaction (0.879) with an overall average usability score of 0.877 from the range of 1 – 5 on a Likert scale. With this research, it is hoped that PikApp Indonesia can improve the website system where the efficiency variable is the lowest variable compared to other variables and by carrying out regular system maintenance.

title: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
title_en: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools
abstract_en: The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students/women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media (Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram) on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach's alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.
combined_text_en: Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools. The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students/women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media (Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram) on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach's alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.

title: Readiness factors for information system strategic planning among universities in developing countries: A systematic review
title_en: Readiness factors for information system strategic planning among universities in developing countries: A systematic review
abstract_en: The implementation of information system strategic planning (ISSP) in higher education institutions is to improve work efficiency, management effectiveness in order to improve organizational competitive advantage. However, the question of whether all universities are ready to implement ISSP as a way to achieve organizational goals has not been answered. This study aims to investigate the readiness phenomena through literature study. The method used is by using the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) instrument to identify readiness factors on the implementation of ISSP, especially among the institutions of higher education in developing countries. This study has identified 10 readiness measurement. There are three categories of measurement, namely people, processes and technologies that represent 11 factors of ISSP readiness measurement in universities.

title: Success model for measuring information system implementation: Literature review
title_en: Success model for measuring information system implementation: Literature review
abstract_en: Many researchers have done research on information systems before; this is because of the breadth of studies or topics about IS. There is some example of a study on how to measure Information System Success by testing instrument factors. Some researchers can produce different judgments regarding the success of implementation of IS; this is because the first definition of success of each researcher is changed, the two perspectives on success assessment, the three variables used, the four implementations in different environments. Several models can be used as references to assess the success of IS, Delone and McLean are examples that are widely used as references, which use six variables in measuring IS implementation. From the model used, later there will be a gap in determining the model, and this becomes an opportunity for the development of the model as follows. The development of models to measure information system success can be done by adoption, adaptation, and combination. This is legitimately valid as long as the development of the model is accompanied by supporting theories. The purpose of this review literature is especially researchers can provide an overview of related to the method of previous researchers. Then it can be used as a framework for solving problems.

title: The Impact of Technological Readiness Factors on User Satisfaction in The Indonesian Local Government Employee Service System
title_en: The Impact of Technological Readiness Factors on User Satisfaction in The Indonesian Local Government Employee Service System
abstract_en: User satisfaction within a system comes to fruition when their initial expectations align with the system's actual performance and user experiences. This alignment underscores the significance of assessing technological preparedness and potential health risks to measure user contentment. This study addresses a pivotal concern related to a database error, leading to system inaccessibility and redundant performance reporting within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. The primary objective of this research is to evaluate the degree of perceived user satisfaction and the influencing factors within this context. The assessment focuses on the interplay of technological readiness and user health risks. This study employs a quantitative research approach and a purposive sampling method. The research integrates the Expectation Confirmation Model and Technology Readiness Index 2.0, incorporating a novel variable known as "perceived susceptibility." The findings underscore a significant majority of respondents, approximately 96%, expressing satisfaction. Critical determinants of system user satisfaction are identified as perceived usefulness and confirmation. The implications of this research extend to providing insights into enhancing technological readiness to elevate user satisfaction levels within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. In addition, the results of this study serve as a reference for subsequent research to dig deeper into the subjects explored in this research.

title: Implementation of server consolidation method on a data center by using virtualization technique: a case study
title_en: Implementation of server consolidation method on a data center by using virtualization technique: a case study
abstract_en: Data center is a place where data and applications placed and run. Those data and applications saved various server based on function of application run such as server of database, proxy, portal, website, application, mikrotic and so on. The more vary application run, the more server types needed. There are several implications when data center encounter “server flood”, including more electrical energy must be provided. In addition to the relationship between energy and the utilization rate is still low, there is still one problem faced by system administrators with the number of servers in the data center, the more the server to be maintained. The maintenance requirement is usually done as a result of periodic maintenance, hardware upgrades, system upgrades and hardware damage. The maintenance process requires a fairly long time, starts from new server preparation, application and system preparation, and also on the network side. The solution that can be done to solve this situation is by using virtualization (VM) of the servers. After several processes, such as categorization process, consolidation, design and implementation, the results made are by using VM terms of energy consumption, it can provide a savings of more than 50%. We conduct the virtualization concept on Syarif Hidayatullah State Islamic University of Jakarta (UIN Jakarta) as our case study. Before VM applied, the consumption of energy used is equal to 7855 watts, whereas after VM applied energy consumption will be 3890 watts. Efficient data center management can be applied and can save time for maintenance. Before the use of the VM, the time required to process improvement at least 3 hours, but after the use of VM takes just less than 1 hour.

title: RANCANG BANGUN KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM BAHAN AJAR ONLINE DALAM MENINGKATKAN KOMPETENSI GURU MTS NEGERI 2 PAMULANG.
title_en: DESIGN AND DESIGN OF A KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM ONLINE TEACHING MATERIALS IN IMPROVING THE COMPETENCY OF MTS NEGERI 2 PAMULANG TEACHERS.
abstract_en: This  research  aims  to  implement  a  knowledge  management  system  of  teaching  materials  in  improving  the  competence  of  MTs  negerian  2  Pamulang teachers. The abilities of  MTs teachers  urgently  need to be  improved. The government and other related parties are required to improve the abilities or competencies of MTs teachers who are spread out. Improving the quality of MTs Teachers through conventional training activities  both  by  central  and  regional  governments  is  very  limited. The system development methodology used in this research is Rapid Application Development which consists of three phases, namely planning, workshop design and implementation. The results of this research mean that MTs teachers can utilize the learning system website, through Sharing Knowledge Management as a learning resource to improve teacher competency that is easy to understand. In particular,  increasing pedagogical competence and professional competence for  MTs teachers. In addition,  it  becomes  a  model  for  the  application  of  Knowledge  Management  System  in  the  learning  system  for  MTs. Keywords: MTs, implementation, competency, Knowledge Management System

abstract_en: Accounting information systems are the backbone of every company, including restaurants. Restaurant Indian Food Delhi6, as a fastfood restaurant operating in Bali, currently still relies on manual methods to record and manage its financial transactions. Although this manual method was effective in the past, along with the increasing number of transactions and business complexity, it began to show a number of weaknesses. To overcome these problems, this study aims to design and develop an integrated VBA Excel-based accounting information system specifically for Restaurant Indian Food Delhi6. This system is expected to automate various repetitive accounting tasks, such as recording sales, purchases, and payroll, thereby reducing employee workload and minimizing human error. In developing this system, the Waterfall and UML methods will be used. The Waterfall method will be used as a framework for overall system development, while UML will be used to model and document various aspects of the system, such as use cases, flowcharts, and class diagrams. The final result of this study is a comprehensive accounting information system design, including use cases, narratives, and an integrated financial system. This system is expected to meet the specific needs of Restaurant Indian Food Delhi6 and be an effective solution to overcome current problems.

title: A rule-based question answering system on relevant documents of Indonesian Quran Translation
title_en: A rule-based question answering system on relevant documents of Indonesian Quran Translation
abstract_en: This paper presents work in development of a question answering (QA) system by using a combination of two different architectures i.e. the one used relevant documents and another used rule-based method, which those two contribute for answer extraction. Base on previous researches testing result, it could be inferred that each of the methods could be a complement for another method in order to increase system performance. This QA was purposed to gather information from Indonesian Quran Translation. The new architecture was designed to gather relevant documents toward the keywords and be used subsequentially to gather answer candidates by using rule-based method. The initial results indicate that system still restricted with retrieved relevant documents, and caused delivering only 60% correct answers. This achievement is not better than the previous one that used rule-based method only.
